mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, sc.name AS sub_category_name, c.name AS category_name, s.keywords FROM spots s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) sp ON true JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.id, s.spot_name AS spotName, s.details, s.business_hours AS businessHours, s.estimated_budget AS estimatedBudget, s.address, s.gmap_url AS gmapUrl, s.website_url AS websiteUrl, c.name AS categoryName, sc.name AS subCategoryName,
stats.avg_rating AS averageRating, stats.review_count AS reviewCount
FROM spots s
INNER JOIN sub_categories sc ON s.sub_category_id = sc.id
INNER JOIN categories c ON sc.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(id) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) stats ON s.id = stats.spot_id
WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
s.id AS spot_id,
r.id AS review_id, r.comment AS comment, u.display_name AS reviewerName, r.created_at AS reviewDate, r.rating AS rating,
sp.id AS photo_id, sp.photo_url AS photoUrl, sp.display_order AS displayOrder
FROM spots s
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON s.id = r.spot_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN spot_photos sp ON s.id = sp.spot_id
WHERE s.id = #{id}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, sp.display_order ASC
